name: Spatial PCA · ambiguity fallback
description: Frozen 95D spatial PCA in four proper sign frames. If either cell has an axis gap < 0.05, distance uses an independent rotation-invariant surface signature, scaled on training cells. MDS depicts these mixed distances; average-linkage groups. The fallback discards chirality and cannot distinguish all shapes. Cell-level only.

name: Surface signature · 95D
description: Geometric descriptor, not a neural encoder: surface radial and pair-distance quantiles, compressed by PCA fitted on the original 96 training cells. Rotation invariant for rigid transforms of the same mesh; sensitive to remeshing and discards chirality.

name: Surface signature · adjusted
description: Surface signature after degree-2 Ridge adjustment for log volume, elongation and sphericity fitted only on the original 96 training cells. Residualization does not guarantee biological independence.

name: Spatial PCA · adjusted summary
description: Mean/std over the four spatial PCA frames, adjusted for log volume, elongation and sphericity using training-only degree-2 Ridge. This pooled view has no ambiguity fallback and can remain alignment-sensitive in near-spherical cells.

name: Volume + elongation + sphericity
description: Training-standardized features: volume_um3, sphericity, elongation. Positive size measures are log transformed.

name: Size features
description: Training-standardized features: volume_um3, surface_area_um2, major_axis_um, middle_axis_um, minor_axis_um. Positive size measures are log transformed.

name: Shape features
description: Training-standardized features: sphericity, elongation, flatness, mesh_solidity. Positive size measures are log transformed.

name: All 9 traditional features
description: Training-standardized features: volume_um3, surface_area_um2, sphericity, elongation, flatness, mesh_solidity, major_axis_um, middle_axis_um, minor_axis_um. Positive size measures are log transformed.

name: All 9 traditional · adjusted
description: Identical training-only degree-2 Ridge adjustment for log volume, elongation and sphericity as the shape comparisons. Residual features need not be independent of these measurements.

name: Spherical harmonics · shell spectrum
description: Rotation-invariant spherical-shell harmonic powers: 32 radial shells, degrees 0–12, soft occupancy sampled from the original mesh. Exact surface centroid/RMS-radius normalization removes position and scale. Independent implementation of the shell-spectrum construction, not SPHARM-PDM. Finite quadrature produces small rotation errors; phase and chirality are lost.

name: Spherical harmonics · adjusted
description: Shell harmonic spectrum after the same training-only degree-2 Ridge adjustment for log volume, elongation and sphericity used by traditional and spatial features. Adjustment is fitted on the original 96 training cells; residuals are not guaranteed independent of controls.

name: CAJAL · quantized GW
description: Official CAJAL 2.0.3 quantized Gromov–Wasserstein comparison, 128 area-sampled surface points, 32 clusters, Euclidean distances within each cell. Position, scale and orientation (including reflections) removed. Cached pairwise distances drive neighbors and MDS; packed rows are not embedding coordinates. Average-linkage groups; cell-level only. Approximation, sampling and solver local minima affect rankings.

name: CAJAL · adjusted landmark profile
description: Distances to the original 96 training cells form a landmark profile, then receive the identical training-only volume/elongation/sphericity adjustment. Euclidean profile distance is an approximation and is not the direct CAJAL GW distance. Organoid plots average included QC cell profiles.

name: Allen VN-DGCNN · released · raw

Frozen inference on all cells for exploration, including excluded/QC-flagged cells for review. Original 609 benchmark codes preserved; no retraining. Analysis membership and QC filters still apply.
